categories.name: Input
categories.description: What the system must receive, with performance or constraint aspects of each input.
dimensions: unexpected or undesired inputs and the required response

categories.name: Output
categories.description: What the system must produce, with performance aspects of each output.
dimensions: timing: response time, update frequency, availability

categories.name: External interface
categories.description: Limits placed on receiving inputs and sending outputs by the external systems' interfaces.
dimensions: physical form or fit of the interface

categories.name: Functional
categories.description: The few top-level functions that together transform all inputs into all outputs. Stated as outputs, not as design.
dimensions: first-level partition of the system function

categories.name: Technology
categories.description: Constraints on technology or components, justified by compatibility or interoperability.

categories.name: Performance trade-off
categories.description: How to compare two alternative designs on aggregate performance, from stakeholder values.
dimensions: weights and value curves over performance measures

categories.name: Cost trade-off
categories.description: How to compare two alternative designs on aggregate cost across phases and payers.

categories.name: Cost-performance trade-off
categories.description: How performance is traded against cost, ideally as willingness to pay.
dimensions: willingness to pay per performance gain

categories.name: Observance
categories.description: Which qualification data is obtained for each input/output and system-wide requirement, and by which method.

categories.name: Verification
categories.description: How qualification data will show the real system conforms to its design.
dimensions: verification system and its own requirements

categories.name: Validation
categories.description: How qualification data will show the real system satisfies the stakeholders' needs, traced to scenarios.
dimensions: validation system and its own requirements

categories.name: Acceptance
categories.description: How qualification data will show the system is acceptable to the stakeholders, and who decides.
